author: sascha
name: Make idea-processing briefings reference all unprocessed repository ideas
description:
Scope: the idea-processing briefing generated by todo/app.js and corresponding PROCESS.md/README instructions.

Replace the copied idea-text payload with a concise instruction to read the authoritative repository board and process every idea that is still unprocessed at execution time. Pending means that no todo in todo/todos/*.json links the idea through source_ideas; ideas remain in todo/data.json. The worker is assumed to have repository access. Keep the planning-only boundary, attribution preservation, overlap checks and current record-scoped safe-write procedure explicit or referenced clearly.

Inspect all processing entry points, including any selected-idea action, and align their labels/behavior with the new all-pending scope so a selected-item control cannot silently imply narrower work. The copied prompt should not embed stale original text or an obsolete list of pending IDs. Re-reading live state and the API's processing-race protection must keep repeated or concurrent runs from duplicating todos. A no-pending run should report that there is nothing to process.

Acceptance: generated idea-processing prompts contain repository/process references rather than idea bodies; processing uses the pending set at execution time; UI copy and procedure agree; representative no-pending and newly-added-idea cases are covered with temporary fixtures. Preserve original records unchanged.

This is a follow-up to completed T0007, not a storage redesign. The request concerns idea-processing briefings; changing implementation or human task briefings to omit their descriptions is outside this scope unless separately requested.
